title: Systematic Theology
author: Charles G. Finney
tradition_notes: Finney was the leading revivalist of the Second Great Awakening. President of Oberlin College 1851-1866. Known for 'new measures' revivalism and his systematic theology emphasizing human agency. Theologically Arminian and anti-confessional; trained as a Congregationalist.
source_edition: CCEL ThML edition (sourced via CCEL.org). Based on the 1878 revised edition (Oberlin, Ohio).
